subject: Business Models
title: Decentralized Marketplaces
description: A quick win: understand Decentralized Marketplaces.

hook.text: What if eBay had no owner? Blockchain-based marketplaces run on code, not corporate boards.

buildup.text: Decentralized marketplaces use smart contracts: automated rules that execute transactions without a middleman.

discovery.text: OpenSea for NFTs showed this works—$23 billion in trading volume with minimal human intervention.

twist.text: OpenSea's volume crashed 99% from its peak. Decentralized doesn't mean demand-proof.

climax.text: Decentralized marketplaces reduce fees but struggle with trust, curation, and dispute resolution.

punchline.text: No middleman, no fees—but also no one to call when things go wrong.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off with decentralized marketplaces?
options: Lower fees but weaker trust and dispute resolution
